services.desc: If you see a class you’re interested in but can’t make it, have a special bug you’ve been saving to pin but want guidance, or want to learn another skill you see products of in the shop, let us know! For a flat fee + supplies, we are more than happy to give you a place to learn & someone to learn from! Email bonesinjars@gmail.com or message us on social media if you’d like to schedule something! Bug Pinning & Display Class is offered two weekend days every month, so if you can’t make it to one, fear not! There will be more.
